title: sideritis vulgaris var. bracteosa
intro: Sideritis vulgaris var. bracteosa, commonly known as Rock Tea, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, which include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rock Tea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. By incorporating Rock Tea into one's regimen, individuals may experience relief from respiratory issues, as well as a reduction in fever and inflammation, thanks to its unique combination of bioactive compounds.
